main_text.head: Ab Ethnicis
A Papistis
main_text.p: Leo X. ad Recatanenses, ut procurent templi Lauretani ædificationem: Ne tum nos, tum etiam DEAM ipsam (Mariam Lauretanam) inani lignorum inutilium donatione lusisse videamini. anno 1514. Epist. 17. lib. 8. apud Jovium.

Lud. Vives in August. l. 8. de C. D. c. ult. Multi Christiani Divos Divasq; non aliter venerantur, quam Deum; nec video in multis, quod sit discrimen inter eorum opinionem de Sanctis, & id quod Gentes putabant de suis diis,

page.notes: Diagram labels in the two columns are set in brace outlines; the brace-linked captions are reproduced as level lines. Some words in the lists are partly illegible due to damage and show-through; "Pā-" and "(theo." are printed as shown. Signature mark "D:" at lower right is a gathering mark.
